description: This PHP class defines the VacancyAttachment entity for a Human Resource Management system, representing file attachments related to job vacancies. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_job_vacancy_attachment' and includes properties such as file name, type, size, content, and related vacancy.

classes.name: VacancyAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a vacancy attachment, including properties for file details and relations to Vacancy.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates this attachment with a Vacancy.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment about the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment about the attachment.
